name: Fenlow Frame 133 EGEO
description: Key Features Large Working Width: 180 cm working width accommodates wide fabrics and larger batch sizes, improving efficiency for textile processing. Precise Temperature Control: Maintains a consistent process temperature of 84°C, ensuring optimal conditions for effective fulvic-bath scouring. Batch Processing Capacity: Handles up to 4 kilograms per batch, suitable for small to medium-scale textile operations. Extended Cycle Time: 75-hour cycle duration supports thorough scouring and deep cleaning, meeting demanding processing requirements. Treadle Drive System: Manual treadle operation allows for energy-efficient, reliable performance without dependence on external power sources. Custom Pricing: Unit price is determined after acceptance, allowing for tailored quotations based on specific customer needs. Main Benefits Enhanced Fabric Cleanliness: Effectively removes impurities and residues from textiles, resulting in cleaner, higher-quality fabric ready for further processing or dyeing. Energy-Efficient Operation: Treadle drive offers a sustainable solution, reducing electricity usage and operating costs. Flexible Batch Sizing: 4 kg throughput supports both small production runs and specialty fabric treatments, addressing diverse manufacturing needs. Consistent Results: Stable temperature and extended cycle time ensure uniform scouring, reducing the risk of uneven results and fabric damage. Adaptable Pricing: Customizable quotations provide cost transparency and flexibility for businesses of all sizes. Typical Use Cases and Outcomes Textile Mills and Dye Houses: Ideal for scouring natural and synthetic fabrics prior to dyeing or finishing processes, improving dye uptake and fabric softness. Artisan and Small-Scale Producers: Suitable for boutique manufacturers seeking precise control over fabric preparation in limited production runs. Research and Development: Useful in laboratory or pilot-scale settings where controlled, repeatable scouring conditions are required. Sustainable Manufacturing: Treadle-driven design supports eco-friendly operations, appealing to businesses focused on sustainability and reduced energy consumption. Frequently Addressed User Needs Durability: Constructed for long cycle times and repeated use, ensuring reliability in demanding textile environments. Ease of Use: Manual treadle system is straightforward to operate and maintain, requiring minimal technical training. Compatibility: Designed for a wide range of fabric types and batch sizes, offering versatility across different textile applications. Value: Custom pricing and energy efficiency contribute to a cost-effective solution for fabric scouring needs.
description_html:
Key Features

  • Large Working Width: 180 cm working width accommodates wide fabrics and larger batch sizes, improving efficiency for textile processing.
  • Precise Temperature Control: Maintains a consistent process temperature of 84°C, ensuring optimal conditions for effective fulvic-bath scouring.
  • Batch Processing Capacity: Handles up to 4 kilograms per batch, suitable for small to medium-scale textile operations.
  • Extended Cycle Time: 75-hour cycle duration supports thorough scouring and deep cleaning, meeting demanding processing requirements.
  • Treadle Drive System: Manual treadle operation allows for energy-efficient, reliable performance without dependence on external power sources.
  • Custom Pricing: Unit price is determined after acceptance, allowing for tailored quotations based on specific customer needs.

Main Benefits

  • Enhanced Fabric Cleanliness: Effectively removes impurities and residues from textiles, resulting in cleaner, higher-quality fabric ready for further processing or dyeing.
  • Energy-Efficient Operation: Treadle drive offers a sustainable solution, reducing electricity usage and operating costs.
  • Flexible Batch Sizing: 4 kg throughput supports both small production runs and specialty fabric treatments, addressing diverse manufacturing needs.
  • Consistent Results: Stable temperature and extended cycle time ensure uniform scouring, reducing the risk of uneven results and fabric damage.
  • Adaptable Pricing: Customizable quotations provide cost transparency and flexibility for businesses of all sizes.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Textile Mills and Dye Houses: Ideal for scouring natural and synthetic fabrics prior to dyeing or finishing processes, improving dye uptake and fabric softness.
  • Artisan and Small-Scale Producers: Suitable for boutique manufacturers seeking precise control over fabric preparation in limited production runs.
  • Research and Development: Useful in laboratory or pilot-scale settings where controlled, repeatable scouring conditions are required.
  • Sustainable Manufacturing: Treadle-driven design supports eco-friendly operations, appealing to businesses focused on sustainability and reduced energy consumption.

Frequently Addressed User Needs

  • Durability: Constructed for long cycle times and repeated use, ensuring reliability in demanding textile environments.
  • Ease of Use: Manual treadle system is straightforward to operate and maintain, requiring minimal technical training.
  • Compatibility: Designed for a wide range of fabric types and batch sizes, offering versatility across different textile applications.
  • Value: Custom pricing and energy efficiency contribute to a cost-effective solution for fabric scouring needs.
